rules.date_notes: When two PSI records list the same start and end dates, both are shown as written with a note; nothing is corrected.
rules.label: year as listed by PSI (end date)
rules.placement: PYRION convention: placed at the year of investigationEndDate; if empty, missionStart; if both are empty: 'date not stated in PSI', drawn only in the final frame.
rules.points: Tests resolved by the engine rule; records with status insufficient_evidence are not used; a range gives both ends; identical points are merged with a test count and the gravity regimes of those tests.
